employee_number, company_size_male, company_size_female, business_summary, company_url, founding_year, date_of_establishment, qualification_grade, inserted_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{corporateNumber}, EXCLUDED.date_of_establishment, qualification_grade = EXCLUDED.qualification_grade, updated_at = NOW() WHERE company.name IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.name OR company.kana IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.kana
